Junior Account Executive Benelux (Dutch-speaking)<p>Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)<br>Contract type: Full-time<br>Salary: Starting from €40,000 OTE per annum gross (60% base / 40% bonus), subject to location, skills and experience.</p><p></p>Not Your Typical Workplace…<p>Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with.</p><p>At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions.</p><p>Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.</p><br>More Than a Role<p>The Benelux market is full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders.</p><p>An Amsterdam scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. An Antwerp founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter.</p><p>As our Junior Account Executive Benelux, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish companies.</p><p>This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence.</p><p>You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you.</p><p>Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.</p><br>Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:<ul><li>Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, from first conversation to onboarded talent.</li></ul><ul><li>Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.</li><li>Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.</li><li>Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.</li><li>Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.</li></ul><br>What It Takes to Make an Impact Here:<ul><li>Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another target-driven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers.</li><li>Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal.</li><li>Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.</li><li>AI-Savvy &amp; Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.</li><li>Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.</li><li>Dutch Native: Native-level Dutch and business-fluent English.</li></ul>Bonus Points If You Bring<ul><li>Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions.</li><li>First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals.</li><li>Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role.</li></ul><br>Not Your Typical Team:<p>We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected."</p><p>We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together.</p><p>We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line.</p><p>If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.</p><br>The Perks of Being Here…<ul><li>Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.</li><li>Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax.</li></ul><ul><li>Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.</li><li>Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training &amp; Development Allowance, you'll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.</li><li>Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!</li><li>Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.</li></ul><p></p><p>Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. </p><p>At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</p><p>If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com. We're here to support you every step of the way!</p>

About the Company<p>Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.</p>About the Role<p>We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.</p><p>You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.</p><p>Location: Pune / Remote</p><p>Experience: 3–6 years</p><p>Type: Full-time</p><p></p>What You’ll Do<ul><li>Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases</li><li>Plan, conduct, and synthesise user interviews, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and journey mapping</li><li>Create actionable outputs like personas, user journeys, service blueprints, and research reports</li><li>Proactively identify users to talk to—whether through clients, internal teams, or customer success</li><li>Translate research insights into product opportunities and design inputs</li><li>Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, and front-end teams throughout the design process</li><li>Help shape our research practice as we scale, including mentoring junior team members when needed</li><li>Proactively identify new opportunities for research&nbsp; within existing client engagements to extend project reach</li></ul><p></p><p></p>
What We’re Looking For<ul><li>3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)</li><li>Direct experience conducting research for enterprise or B2B products (SaaS, healthcare, platforms, or internal tools)</li><li>Comfort working with US-based users and stakeholders, and ability to adapt research communication accordingly</li><li>Strong system-level thinking: you can map workflows, identify gaps, and untangle complex journeys</li><li>Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process</li><li>Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps</li><li>Excellent verbal and written communication, with a knack for explaining research to cross-functional teams</li></ul><p></p>Bonus Points If You Have<ul><ul><li>Experience working in healthcare, automation, or other complex, high-stakes domains</li><li>Exposure to continuous discovery practices alongside product teams</li><li>Comfort engaging with product owners and client stakeholders to shape research direction and priorities</li></ul></ul>
<ul><li>Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning &amp; professional trainings).</li><li>Flexible working hours and remote options.</li><li>A collaborative and innovative team culture.</li><li>Opportunity for career growth and leadership roles.</li></ul><p></p><p>Koru UX Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.</p>

<p>Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.</p>
<p>This is a dual-focus principal role. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. <p>You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.</p>

<li>Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.</li>
<li>Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.</li>
<li>Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.</li>
<li>Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.</li>
<li>Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.</li>
<li>Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.</li>
<li>Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.</li>

<p>Preferred Qualifications</p>

<li>Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.</li>
<li>Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.</li>
<li>Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.</li>
<li>Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.</li>
<li>A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.</li>
<li>Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.</li>
<li>Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.</li>
<li>Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.</li>

<p><strong>Travel Requirements &amp; Working Conditions</strong></p>

<p>Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. <h2><strong>About Contra Labs</strong></h2>
<p>Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.</p>
<p>By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.</p>
<h2><strong>How It Works</strong></h2>
<p>This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.</p>
<h2><strong>To Join the Network</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content"><strong>Portfolio review</strong> - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content"><strong>Record a 30 second intro video</strong>&nbsp;- Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content"><strong>Complete profile</strong>&nbsp;- Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What You May Work On</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Evaluate AI-generated games and interactive experiences for gameplay quality, technical execution, and overall player experience</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Provide clear, structured feedback on gameplay loops, mechanics, controls, physics, level design, UI, visual feedback, and overall game feel</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated games should look, feel, and play like</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Identify common failure modes in AI-generated games, including broken gameplay loops, poor collision or physics logic, unresponsive controls, and disjointed player feedback</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Build or evaluate playable prototypes and reference experiences that demonstrate best-in-class game design and technical execution</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate compelling, polished, and playable interactive experiences</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality game design, interactive experiences, or playable projects</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Strong understanding of game mechanics, gameplay loops, player experience, controls, and visual feedback</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Strong game design instincts and awareness of contemporary games, mechanics, interaction patterns, and player expectations</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="bn-inline-content">Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, game engines, or rapid prototyping tools is a plus)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
